name: Sunfish 07 original arcade hydroplane
positiveHeading: Bow rotates toward screen right; angle 0 is directly rear-facing.
alpha: Straight RGBA PNG transparency; no ground, water, character, wake, or dither.
anchorUnits: Pixels from top-left of the full 768 x 512 frame, before any cropping.
cropping: Each full tile is the same size. alphaBounds is per-frame tight visible content. uniformCrop is shared across all nine frames at the same elevation. Cropped-atlas anchors subtract uniformCrop.x/y.
